scripts.build:release: pnpm --filter @connexto/frontend build && node scripts/sync-frontend-dist.mjs && go -C apps/backend build -o ../../bin/ai-hub ./cmd/ai-hub/
scripts.check: go -C apps/backend vet ./... && go -C apps/backend test ./... -count=1 -race && pnpm --filter @connexto/frontend check
scripts.e2e: pnpm --dir e2e install && pnpm --dir e2e exec playwright install chromium && pnpm --dir e2e test
